description: Wave 4c: entity snapshot deltas, before/after on the olife_load composition (6 bots with predicted movement, blocks every 20 ticks, real sandbox with scripted entities, mobs). Phase 1: old EntitySnapshot (f32 positions of every changed entity every tick); phase 2: EntityDelta (per-session baseline, 1/256-block quantised deltas, u16 slots, no resend when unchanged, keyframe every 100 ticks, distance priority + 1200 B/tick/session budget). Bytes per tick: entity snapshots (world) and all downstream traffic (gateway); phase 3: the same delta with a tight budget (60 B/tick/session) and decimation from 4 blocks — moves are deferred/decimated (priority by distance and age), the baseline keeps hashes exact; per-tick replica hash consistency over all phases (the mode switch despawns/respawns every view).
